# testdata/test_element_ref_count.sngl, executed: nothing runs that fixture's
# assertions, and what a ref names is the interpreter's answer as much as the
# checker's. An instance's refs are its own body's, a child's are reached
# through the child's id, and each instance -- two siblings, the copies a loop
# renders, the levels of a recursion -- keeps its own.

sngl test --platform none refs.sngl
stdout '5 tests, 0 failures'

-- refs.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output {
    none { html }
}

component child node {
    var count = 0

    button #bump(text="+", @click { count += 1 })
    text #shows(value="{count}")
}

component two node {
    vbox {
        child #left()
        child #right()
    }
}

func testSiblingsAreIndependent(t Test, c two) {
    c.left.bump.click()
    t.assert(c.left.shows.value == "1")
    t.assert(c.right.shows.value == "0")
}

component copies node {
    for var n = [1, 2, 3] {
        child #kid()
    }
}

func testLoopCopiesAreIndependent(t Test, c copies) {
    c.kid[1].bump.click()
    t.assert(c.kid.length() == 3)
    t.assert(c.kid[0].shows.value == "0")
    t.assert(c.kid[1].shows.value == "1")
}

component countdown(n = 0) node {
    text #step(value=string(n))
    if n > 0 {
        countdown #next(n=n - 1)
    }
}

component start node {
    countdown #top(n=2)
}

func testEachLevelHoldsItsOwn(t Test, c start) {
    t.assert(c.top.step.value == "2")
    var one = c.top.next
    t.assert(one != null)
    if one != null {
        t.assert(one.step.value == "1")
    }
}

component panel(children ...component) node {
    vbox {
        text #title(value="panel")
        children
    }
}

component filled node {
    var hits = 0

    panel #p {
        button #go(text="go", @click { hits += 1 })
    }
}

func testBareChildrenAreTheWriters(t Test, c filled) {
    c.go.click()
    t.assert(c.hits == 1)
    t.assert(c.p.title.value == "panel")
}

component maybe node {
    var open = false

    if open {
        child #kid()
    }
}

func testAnInstanceBehindAnIfIsAnOption(t Test, c maybe) {
    t.assert(c.kid == null)
    c.open = true
    if c.kid != null {
        c.kid.bump.click()
        t.assert(c.kid.shows.value == "1")
    }
    t.assert(c.kid != null)
}

window {
    two()
}
